title: Bức ảnh cũ
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"): C minor at 62 bpm. Its motif wavers on one note (G-Ab-G), as a memory flickers, then rises up the chord (C-Eb) and settles a step below on the next chord's third; sung again from C over A-flat. The arc: the piano alone; the cellos' slow second line; in the middle the cellos sing a new tune of their own in E-flat while the violas hold a thin line above and the piano only its deep notes; then the piano takes that tune two octaves up for the climax, the strings holding the chords and the piano rolling them, the wavering motif at its top; the piano again with the violas at the sentences' ends; the motif once more to close, on the fifth. An original tune.
